The documentary Amrao Pari (We Too Can), filmed by 16 Bangladeshi teenagers and broadcast on ATN Bangla, won an International Emmy Award in 2004 (between 2001 and 2010). ATN Bangla is connected to the Asian Television Network (ATN), a Canadian broadcasting company. In 2015, more than 10 years after the 2004 Emmy win, ATN Canada produced a motivational TV show called The Achievers, where Dr. Shan Chandrasekar, President and CEO of ATN, served as host and interviewer. Shan Chandrasekar's wife is Jaya Chandrasekar, who hosted a long-running series called Asian Horizons starting in the early 1970s.
